ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Employer and insurer contracts, Discovery and later stages need Covered headcount, Sites covered and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Employer_insurer_contracts", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Proposal", 3, "Governance review", 4, "Pilot", 5, "Contract out", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Covered_headcount__c), ISBLANK(Sites_covered__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Covered headcount, Sites covered and Next step date before moving to Discovery.
